verdict: Paid Instagram is punching above its weight; reputation and intake are the weak links.
diagnosis: Instagram lead ads delivered 449 leads this period at roughly $24 each, well under the legal industry average, but a one-star review and slow organic growth drag the brand.

signals.headline: 449 leads from Instagram this period
signals.detail: The August Re-Launch campaign produced 449 lead actions on $10,894 spent, averaging about $24 per lead.

signals.headline: Reach hit 137,441 people
signals.detail: Ads reached 137,441 unique users with a frequency of 1.16, meaning most saw the ad once. Room to scale.

signals.headline: 183 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: The Business Profile drove 183 phone taps this period but zero direction requests, suggesting phone-first intake.

signals.headline: One-star review pulled rating to 4.67
signals.detail: A new one-star review landed this period, dropping average rating. Two new reviews total, uneven mix.

signals.headline: Instagram following stuck at 35
signals.detail: Followers flat at 35 with only 30 profile visits. Organic presence is not keeping pace with paid reach.

recommendations.title: Respond publicly to the one-star review
recommendations.detail: A measured, professional reply shows prospects you take complaints seriously. Consider also asking recent happy clients for reviews to dilute the impact on your 4.67 average.

recommendations.title: Test scaling the winning August Re-Launch ad
recommendations.detail: At $24 per lead you have room to raise daily budget before costs climb. Worth testing a 25-50% budget lift on Video Ad 04 V4 while watching cost per lead.

recommendations.title: Track what happens after the lead form
recommendations.detail: The CRM pipeline shows no data this period. Consider connecting intake outcomes so you can see which of the 449 leads became paying clients.
